modules.name: Vinylizer Fable
modules.description: The sound of a 90s record from the physics of the chain, no crackle: elliptic EQ, cutter HF limiter, record curve and cut level, lacquer / DMM / dub plate, stylus tracing and inner groove distortion, tracking and mistracking, MM cartridge loading, arm resonance and warps, platter wow, and the phono preamp

modules.name: Vinylizer Master
modules.description: Expander for Vinylizer Fable (place on its left): the master handed to the cutting engineer. Half-inch or quarter-inch tape with drive, print-through, noise reduction error and hiss, 1630 and DAT early digital converters, emphasis mistakes, the lathe's digital delay line, and CD-style limiting

modules.name: Vinylizer Pressing
modules.description: Expander for Vinylizer Fable (place on its right): a poor pressing, made in the groove and read by the stylus. Virgin, regrind, styrene, flexi and picture disc stock, surface noise, non-fill, stamper wear, disc weight, dust and stylus fluff, scratches, cue burn, with once-per-turn and skip outputs
